verdict.rationale: Netlify documents "Automatic HTTPS" as a platform feature, and community users confirm free custom domains with SSL, so the product itself provides TLS for custom domains. Nothing in the evidence covers automatic renewal, wildcard certificates, or explicit coverage of every domain. A single community report of cert errors that support fixed does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: documented wildcard certificate support, explicit automatic renewal, first-party confirmation that certificates are free across all plans and domains.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Netlify is amazing: Free, good support, custom domains with SSL
